results.name: azureMonitorSliServiceGroup
results.reason: Exact current 2024-02-01-preview and latest stable GA 2026-08-01 Learn/REST schemas were compared. Both are tenant-scoped and retain the same serviceGroupName pattern, displayName:string, and parent.resourceId:string/arm-id contract; GA only adds optional attributes. Source create bodies supply displayName and parent. Existing is a reference declaration, so create-only body requirements are not missing.
results.migration: GA migration is structurally compatible: stable 2026-08-01 is the latest published GA and preserves every used field and the resource-name pattern. The source name expression truncates to 90 characters; deployment-time environment/optional resource-ID inputs remain dynamic and were not queried.

findings.detail: Current API is preview 2024-02-01-preview; exact stable GA 2026-08-01 is available. The GA schema keeps the same name pattern, tenant route, displayName, and parent.resourceId; its only change is optional properties.attributes, so all source-used fields remain supported.

usage.label: scope
usage.analysis: Bicep scope tenant() selects the tenant-level deployment endpoint; it is not REST JSON. Both Learn versions and both OpenAPI paths target Tenant scope.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Original /name maps to required REST path parameter serviceGroupName:string with pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_().]{1,90}$. The root expression is azureMonitorSliServiceGroupName, built from sg-, appName, environment, and uniqueString, then truncated to at most 90 characters; default fixed components use allowed characters, while AZURE_ENV_NAME is a deployment-time input.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: REST ServiceGroup.properties is optional. The create declarations supply displayName and parent; exact types and formats are checked in their child usage entries. The existing declaration is reference-only and does not require create properties.

usage.label: displayName
usage.analysis: REST properties.displayName is string without enum or format constraints. Source interpolates appName and environment in the root declaration, or receives the documented string parameter in the reusable module.

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: REST properties.parent is ParentServiceGroupProperties; its child resourceId is checked separately. Do not confuse this REST relationship with the Bicep scope tenant() deployment target.

usage.label: resourceId
usage.analysis: REST properties.parent.resourceId is string with format arm-id. Root/module source supplies either the tenant root Service Group ARM ID or the explicit parentServiceGroupResourceId input, whose description identifies it as a Service Group resource ID.

current.analysis: Fetched exact preview Learn reference and pinned preview OpenAPI. ServiceGroup has tenant-level path; ServiceGroupProperties exposes string displayName and parent.resourceId string/arm-id. The path name is required string with regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_().]{1,90}$. Current source supplies displayName and parent; existing declaration is reference-only.

ga.analysis: Learn version selector labels 2026-08-01 as Latest and pinned REST README maps package-2026-08 to stable/2026-08-01/serviceGroups.json. Exact candidate schema preserves the tenant route, name regex, displayName:string, and parent.resourceId:string/arm-id. Its ServiceGroupProperties adds optional attributes; the source does not use it. The exact GA PUT example confirms parent.resourceId payload shape.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log for 2026-08-01 lists only addition of ServiceGroupAttributes and addition of optional ServiceGroupProperties.attributes. No removal or change is listed for displayName, parent, or parent.resourceId. Microsoft Learn uniqueString reference was read for the generated-name suffix (13 characters).
